paper_metadata.title: Visual Instruction Tuning
paper_metadata.abstract: Instruction tuning large language models (LLMs) using machine-generated instruction-following data has improved zero-shot capabilities on new tasks, but the idea is less explored in the multimodal field. In this paper, we present the first attempt to use language-only GPT-4 to generate multimodal language-image instruction-following data. By instruction tuning on such generated data, we introduce LLaVA: Large Language and Vision Assistant, an end-to-end trained large multimodal model that connects a vision encoder and LLM for general-purpose visual and language understanding.Our early experiments show that LLaVA demonstrates impressive multimodel chat abilities, sometimes exhibiting the behaviors of multimodal GPT-4 on unseen images/instructions, and yields a 85.1% relative score compared with GPT-4 on a synthetic multimodal instruction-following dataset. When fine-tuned on Science QA, the synergy of LLaVA and GPT-4 achieves a new state-of-the-art accuracy of 92.53%. We make GPT-4 generated visual instruction tuning data, our model and code base publicly available.

extraction_data.innovation: Visual instruction tuning: aligns a frozen pre-trained CLIP visual encoder with a frozen pre-trained LLM (Vicuna) via a learnable projection layer, trained on 158K GPT-4-generated instruction-following samples to enable visual instruction following without full model pre-training, improving upon prior methods that required full model pre-training or lacked instruction-following capabilities.
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: 158K GPT-4-generated language-image instruction-following samples (58K conversations, 23K detailed descriptions, 77K complex reasoning)
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Supervised instruction tuning for multimodal chat and visual reasoning, Visual instruction tuning, Supervised fine-tuning on visual instruction data
extraction_data.research_problem: Visual instruction tuning for general-purpose visual and language understanding
extraction_data.application: Visual question answering, image captioning, visual reasoning, instruction following
extraction_data.finetuning_data: GPT-4-generated multimodal instruction-following data, ScienceQA, GPT-4 generated multimodal instruction data from COCO, multimodal chat data, LLaVA-Instruct-158K, LLaVA-Pretrain-558K, ShareGPT-4V
extraction_data.training_pipeline: End-to-end fine-tuning on generated instruction-following data
extraction_data.synthetic_data_generation_method: GPT-4-generated multimodal instruction-following data, GPT-4 generation with human curation
extraction_data.safety_evaluation_protocol: OpenAI Filter API for text input, NSFW Filter for image input
extraction_data.vision_encoder: CLIP, CLIP ViT-L/14, CLIP vision encoder
extraction_data.benchmark_result: 85.1% relative score compared with GPT-4 on a synthetic multimodal instruction-following dataset; 92.53% accuracy on ScienceQA; ScienceQA: 90.92% (13B), 89.84% (7B)
extraction_data.post_training_infrastructure: FSDP (Full Shard Data Parallel) and gradient checkpointing
